Elena: Quick help — candidate for SRE onsite running ~20m late (train delay). Can someone cover the 1:00pm slot or swap to 1:30? Need scribe + debrief lead. Candidate is fine shifting 30m. @Samir @Maya
Samir: I can take debrief lead if someone else scribes. I have 1:00–1:45 free.
Maya: I can scribe and take the technical interview at 1:15 if we go 1:30 start. Prefer not to lead debrief.
Priya: I can add a scribe to the calendar event and update the candidate packet. Link: https://drive.redwood/candidate/sre-123 (note: sensitive)
Elena: Thanks. If we do 1:30 start -> plan: 30m tech (Maya), 15m debrief (Samir). Priya — please update calendar and include Zoom.
people-ops-bot: Calendar event updated: "SRE onsite - candidate X" moved 13:00 -> 13:30. Invitees notified.
Alex: fyi I pushed a quick takehome review in PR #452 — not required for interview but helpful context. @eng please skim before 1:30 if available.
Samir: will skim PR now, can add 2 bullet points to the debrief doc.
Maya: AV check — do we have a room + laptop with screen share? I might be in office A.
Priya: Room A-3 reserved for 1:15–2:00, laptop booked. I added recording consent line to the invite.
Elena: Great. Quick rubric note — use standard SRE rubric, emphasis on incident debugging and postmortem thinking. Weighting unchanged (technical 70 / collaboration 30).
Samir: noted. I'll capture score anchors in the debrief doc during the 15m.
Alex: tagging @eng-reviews — if someone can leave a 3-line note on PR #452 it helps context.
Maya: I'm good to scribe. If candidate still delayed >15m we push to 2pm and Priya — please trigger cancellation notice.
Priya: Will send a 15-min warning if still delayed at 1:45.
Elena: Thank you all :pray: — keeping this thread as the single source for swaps/notes.
